core.title: Surface Mount Electromagnetic Lock, Locknetics MG600-2

text.description_html:
Locknetics MG600-2 Surface Mount Electromagnetic Lock

The MG Series of surface mount electromagnetic locks provides a cost competitive, slim profile and dependable solution for a variety of applications. Designed for up to 600 lb. or 1200 lb. holding strength for both single and double electromagnetic locks.

Features of the Locknetics MG600-2 Surface Mount Electromagnetic Lock:

  • Bi-colored LED sensor provides easy lock status identification
  • Adjustable mounting plate for quick, simple installation
  • Removable PCB for easy installation
  • Built-in voltage spike suppressor
  • Dual voltage: 12 VDC @ 0.5A/24 VDC @ 0.25A
  • Field selectable 12/24 VDC
  • Indoor use only
  • UL 10C and UL294 Listed
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

Specifications:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Lock: 19-3/4" x 1-7/8" x 1-1/16"
  • Armature (each): 7-5/16" x 1-1/2" x 1/2"

Sold Individually
